title: The crests travel at c = lambda nu
spoken: The speed c equals the wavelength times the frequency.
explanation: If nu crests pass a point each second, each a wavelength lambda behind the last, the pattern moves lambda nu metres each second.
assumptions: A single wave of one frequency, travelling along x in empty space.
A foundation lesson's statement in modern notation; not a transcription of the printed paper.

notes.title: Wavelength times frequency
notes.explanation: nu crests pass each second, each a wavelength apart.

notes.title: What it asserts
notes.explanation: The crests move one wavelength for each cycle.

notes.title: Speed of light
notes.explanation: c, the speed of the crests.

notes.title: Wavelength
notes.explanation: The distance from one crest to the next.

notes.title: Frequency
notes.explanation: The number of crests passing a point each second.
